questions.prompt: Do you use a portable heater in this room?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Portable heater. Answer yes if you use a plug-in or portable heater in this room.

questions.prompt: Is the heater close to curtains, bedding or other fabric?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Heater near fabric. Answer yes if the heater sits close to curtains, bedding or other soft furnishings.

questions.prompt: Is an extension cord in use in this room?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Extension cord. Answer yes if anything in this room is plugged into an extension cord.

questions.prompt: Is any power bar full, or plugged into another power bar?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Power bar. Answer yes if a power bar has every socket used, or is plugged into another power bar.

questions.prompt: Do you burn candles with a real flame in this room?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Candles. Answer yes if you light candles with a real flame in this room.

questions.prompt: Is there a stove, hot plate or other cooking appliance in this room?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Cooking appliance. Answer yes if this room has a stove, hot plate or other cooking appliance.

questions.prompt: Is anything blocking the door or the window you would leave by in an emergency?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Blocked exit. Answer yes if furniture or belongings block the way out of this room.

questions.prompt: Is there an air conditioner in the window?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Window air conditioner. Answer yes if an air-conditioning unit sits in a window of this room.

questions.prompt: Is there a water heater inside your unit?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Water heater. Answer yes if a hot-water tank or water heater is inside your unit.

questions.prompt: Do you keep jewellery, cameras, laptops, TVs or instruments worth over $2,500 in total here?
questions.accessibilityLabel: High-value items. Answer yes if jewellery, cameras, laptops, TVs or instruments here are worth more than 2,500 dollars in total.

questions.prompt: How many working smoke detectors are in your unit?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Smoke detectors. Enter how many working smoke detectors are in your unit. Enter 0 if there are none.

questions.prompt: About what year was your building built?
questions.accessibilityLabel: Year built. Enter the year your building was built, as four digits. A best guess is fine.

questions.prompt: How long do you want the policy to last?
